summary: First-iteration full-stack testing of Golf Scorecard app. All backend endpoints and all critical frontend flows pass. No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses `logger` inside courses_nearby before it is defined below the function body. Works because module-level logger is created at import time before requests, but recommend moving logging.basicConfig / logger definition above the routes for clarity.
GET /api/courses/{course_id} returns 200 with defaults even for unknown IDs. Acceptable per design (auto-generated holes), but consider validating IDs if a strict lookup is later required.
Frontend saveRound is best-effort and silently ignored on failure; a small toast/log would help debuggability.
seed_data_creation: Tests create round docs prefixed with TEST_ in db.rounds; not cleaned up (retention low-impact).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All 4 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_golf_api.py pass (root, nearby sorted, course detail 18-hole default, POST /rounds + GET /rounds with no _id). Frontend Playwright flow verified end-to-end: home (permission denied path), change course + search filter (row count=1 for 'royal'), course selection, START ROUND enabled, round screen shows hole 1/18 with par/distance/index, +/- steppers update score/putts, Next then Previous preserved score=6 & putts=3, reload during round resumed hole 1 with score=6 (autosave OK), Next disabled behaviour: on hole 18 finish-round-button replaces next-hole-button, Summary shows total-score, total-putts, 18 summary rows. All testIDs work.
